items: Climate Stress is not landslide probability.
CHIRPS v3 Final is a 0.05° gridded climatology used to anchor planning rainfall contexts, not station intensity and not a real-time forecast.
The city screen is a prioritization proxy, not a dynamic climate forecast or investment recommendation.
The city hazard-exposure proxy assumes projected population is uniformly distributed inside each barrio.
The 2023 IMCV/AMPI socioeconomic component is comuna-level and therefore coarse within individual barrios.
Detailed-sandbox population is a census-based planning proxy, not a current household count.
USD figures in the decision brief are a pre-feasibility implementation envelope, not an offer, contract or engineering estimate.
Benefit, equity and access metrics are planning proxies, not people saved/protected or avoided losses.
Policy-objective weights are transparent development settings and require stakeholder co-design.
The sampled non-dominated set is not an exhaustive mathematical Pareto frontier.
Community evidence is not a prediction of social acceptance.
Technically robust does not mean community-validated.
Absence of community records means not assessed, never support, opposition or low risk.
